# MegaSystem

<!-- Generated from manifest.json by scripts/build.js. Do not edit by hand. -->

Uruguayan online store for phone repair parts (screens, batteries, charging boards), tools and phone accessories, with physical stores. Ships across Uruguay by transport agency.

## Shopping notes

Catalog is mostly repair parts, tools and supplies for phones, aimed at repair shops as well as consumers. Shipping cost depends on agency and locality.
